# Hook-based filtering of agent output — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for Hook-based filtering of agent output. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-09-23 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Hooks cannot directly modify assistant message text. Stop can only prevent stopping and continue the conversation, and last_assistant_message on Stop/SubagentStop is read-only input for analysis. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-23) — https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks · keywords: Hook-based filtering of agent output · also: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/hooks

## Facts and statements

- [statement] A Stop hook can act as a post-generation filter: it inspects the final response and blocks with a reason, forcing the model to revise before the user sees the result. (medium confidence) — https://dev.to/hexisteme/stop-hooks-as-hard-constraints-enforcing-claude-code-behavior-outside-the-model-1g6b · keywords: Hook-based filtering of agent output · also: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks
- [statement] A regex-only Stop hook produces false positives; combining the regex with a second condition (e.g. prior tool-call activity) removes most of them. (low confidence) — https://dev.to/hexisteme/stop-hooks-as-hard-constraints-enforcing-claude-code-behavior-outside-the-model-1g6b
- [statement] A Stop hook that re-blocks without checking stop_hook_active can loop indefinitely; one reported case ran about 50 minutes and consumed the session quota. A nag-once pattern (block the first violation, let an identical repeat pass) avoids it. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-05-03) — https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/55754 · keywords: Hook-based filtering of agent output · also: https://dev.to/hexisteme/stop-hooks-as-hard-constraints-enforcing-claude-code-behavior-outside-the-model-1g6b
- [statement] PostToolUse can replace a tool's output before the model sees it (updatedToolOutput), so filtering applies to tool results but not to the model's own prose. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-23) — https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/hooks · keywords: Hook-based filtering of agent output · also: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks
